misreadings.quote: Once he is gone, Mr. Samsa will order the three lodgers out of his apartment at once.
misreadings.evidence: no support in the text. The lodgers have just given notice themselves: "I immediately cancel my room" and "We also give immediate notice." Gregor's departure and any order from his father lie beyond what has been read.
misreadings.explanation: It states as fact a future event that the text has not reached and that the text does not set up. The lodgers are already leaving of their own accord, and it assumes Gregor will be "gone".

result.note: The translation stays faithful to the text. The reflection has one unsupported future claim stated as fact, and its other claims about the father, Grete and the compromise match the passage.
